events.title: 노팅엄 포리스트 announce plans to relocate from the City Ground to a new 50,000-seat stadium by 2014. Scarborough , who were relegated from the Conference North this season but are best remembered for being Football League members from 1897 to 1999, go out of business with debts of £2.5million.
Five days after the demise of the 128-year-old Scarborough FC, a new club – Scarborough Athletic – is formed.
